Embedding request with encoding_format base64 decodes to a float array embedding

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { EmbeddingFormat, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.embed({ encodingFormat: EmbeddingFormat.Base64, input: "Test input", model: "text-embedding-3-small" });
  console.log(result.data);
  console.log(result.data[0].embedding);
}

void main();
```
